sanctuary.title:
Northern snow quality,
town-run prices.
sanctuary.lead: A small municipal hill near downtown Nakagawa—one rope tow, two runs, and genuine northern Hokkaido snow for ¥400. Local elementary schools train here; a true neighborhood "snow sandbox."
sanctuary.noticeBody: The rope tow takes a midday break—arrival timing matters. Opening dates depend on snow cover; call the Board of Education (01656-7-2877) before you drive.
sanctuary.imgAlt: Night-lit town hill—quiet northern Hokkaido snow

primary.title: Snowfall API × town portal
primary.lead: Snow and weather data that the official site only relays indirectly—surfaced on a live LP dashboard (plan). Closures, night hours, and rope-tow breaks disclosed openly—the trust layer for subscription-style outreach.
primary.imgAlt: Untouched powder on a compact town hill

secondary.title: ¥400 town skiing
secondary.lead: Adult day ticket ¥400, single ride ¥40, free for junior high and under. Skip mega-resort crowds and prices—experience northern Hokkaido's local snow culture as-is.

pass.title:
¥400—your ticket
to northern powder.
pass.lead: Rent a car at Asahikawa Airport and head north on Route 40 to the hill beside Teshio-Nakagawa Station. A half-day package (plan): ¥400 for authentic northern snow.

hike.title:
10 minutes from the station,
into town skiing.
hike.lead: 10 minutes on foot from JR Teshio-Nakagawa (3 by car). Few signs, deeply local—a quiet hill even guidebooks skip. The "hidden" northern Hokkaido experience.
hike.leadCurry: After runs, Teshio River Onsen (Otoifuke) or Bifuka Onsen—position Nakagawa as a base for a northern Hokkaido loop.
hike.imgAlt: JR Teshio-Nakagawa Station in winter snow

tour.title:
From Asahikawa Airport,
done in half a day.
tour.lead: Monetize the gap between mega-resort days—a half-day journey to ¥400 town powder.

sanctuary.title: Town hill complete guide
sanctuary.body: One rope tow, two runs, ~20 m vertical. Too small for most guidebooks—yet local schools train here and day tickets cost ¥400. A microcosm of northern local snow culture.

workation.title: Snowfall-linked dashboard plan
workation.body: Surface snow and weather that the town portal only relays indirectly—shown live on the LP. Transparent closures, night skiing, and rope-tow breaks as the trust base for subscription outreach.

lake.title: Northern powder corridor
lake.body: Bifuka, Otoifuke, Nakagawa—small municipal hills along Route 40. Differentiate from mega-resorts with quiet runs, local prices, and transparent ops info.
